decision: Authorize exactly one file beyond the E05 write scope of src/epistemic_foundry/effects/v4_e05/**: the package marker src/epistemic_foundry/effects/__init__.py. No other path outside the grant is added, and the file contains a docstring only — it declares no vocabulary, no API and no behaviour. E05 otherwise writes only under its granted scope and artifacts/work_packages/E05/**; the engine composes the existing evolution_chamber.reconciliation, evolution_chamber.mutation and noetic_ledger.receipts surfaces rather than reimplementing them, and holds no canonical schema enum value as a string literal.
rationale: pyproject.toml discovers packages with setuptools find_packages (where = ['src']), which requires __init__.py at every level. Verified empirically: without the marker, find_packages returns nothing for epistemic_foundry.effects.v4_e05 while find_namespace_packages finds it, so the module would import at runtime from a source checkout but be silently omitted from the built wheel. That is precisely the source/dist divergence the sealed B04 build gate exists to prevent, and shipping a runtime module that is absent from the distribution would be a hidden gap rather than an implementation. Changing the discovery mode in pyproject.toml was rejected: pyproject is B04's sealed territory, and switching the whole project to namespace discovery to accommodate one package would alter packaging behaviour repository-wide. Adding the marker is the smaller, local and reversible act.
